cc:Work.dc:title: Split nonbonded interactions
cc:Work.dc:description: Exact implemented split nonbonded energy. Universal WCA core below 2^(1/6) sigma; pair-specific LJ attraction above that radius, shifted to zero at 2.5 sigma. The step-gated tail produces an energy jump at its onset. Neighboring bonded beads are excluded.
